'''Bandor Ootka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point during the conflict, Ootka stayed at a Separatist safe-house on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] while on leave from a [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. While he was in the house, Ootka was visited by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] weapon [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Doon Gorot]], who was acting as a go-between for a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who was working for the Separatists. The pair discussed a weapons shipment that was ready for the Separatists to collect from [[Mezhra Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] Clack'dor VII, and Ootka paid Gorot 500,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the consignment.
